answer: The delta graph is validated at intake and the yarrow frontier is published, which means the ancestry of every answer is public, and ferrous anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 4 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. Verification costs 22 dollars and 1 days per identity, which turns a 3269 account sybil into a 12 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
